com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Create a named client in the connected workspace, with an optional client code. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview creating a fictional practice client named Fictional Meadow Freight, with client code DEMO-MF. Wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_create_client, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare creation of a named client in the connected workspace. Requires confirmation and the existing workspace write entitlement.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token
